description: Application for a Non-Material Amendment (S96a) to planning permission ref: 223366FUL dated 15/02/2023 for: Conversion of existing building from 6no. flats into 9no. self-contained residential units; single storey, part 2 storey and part 3 storey, side/rear/side (wraparound) extension; creation of balconies and roof terraces to rear elevation; rear roof extension including increase in ridge height; alterations to fenestration; installation of front boundary wall; and provision of associated amenity space, car parking, refuse and cycle storage. Amendment seeks alterations to the size and positioning of rear fenestration; alterations to positioning of windows to north flank elevation; level changes to side passage and repositioning of approved access gate; and provision of further detail in relation to construction methodology with reference to the front façade
